thought.text: The bug is clear: the slice end is computed as `start + per_page - 1` (inclusive), but Python slices are exclusive, so the last item of each full page is dropped.

reasoning_content:
The bug: `end = start + per_page - 1` and slice `raw_items[start:end]` excludes end. Should be `end = start + per_page`. Let me fix.

Also page_numbers may be fine. Let me just fix the off-by-one. Run tests before and after perhaps.

Let me check git status too.
